tool_schemas.name: getLifelogs
tool_schemas.description: Lists the authenticated user’s lifelog entries and returns a paged result set using offset/limit, optionally filtered by started_at/ended_at ranges, status, source_provider, language, tag, participant, and sorted by started_at or created_at. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not permitted to access lifelogs, VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter has an invalid date-time, enum value, or out-of-range limit/offset (limit 1–200, offset ≥ 0), and RATE_LIMITED when the client exceeds its request quota. Date range filters must be logically consistent (e.g., *_gte must be ≤ the corresponding *_lte) or a VALIDATION_ERROR is returned.

started_at_gte.description: Only return entries with started_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

started_at_lte.description: Only return entries with started_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

ended_at_gte.description: Only return entries with ended_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

ended_at_lte.description: Only return entries with ended_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

language.description: Filter entries by language code (as stored on the entry).

tag.description: Filter to entries that contain this tag.

participant.description: Filter to entries that include this participant.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip before returning results.

tool_schemas.name: getLifelogEntry
tool_schemas.description: Retrieve a specific lifelog entry by its ID. Get detailed information about a particular recorded moment from your Limitless AI pendant.

entry_id.description: The lifelog entry ID to retrieve.

include_assets.description: Whether to include associated lifelog entry assets in the response.

tool_schemas.name: searchLifelogs
tool_schemas.description: Search through your lifelog entries from Limitless AI. Find specific conversations, topics, or moments by searching through the content and summaries of your recorded activities.

query.description: Free-text query to search across entry content_text and summary.

started_at_gte.description: Only search entries with started_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

started_at_lte.description: Only search entries with started_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

ended_at_gte.description: Only search entries with ended_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

ended_at_lte.description: Only search entries with ended_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

status.description: Filter searched entries by lifecycle status.

source_provider.description: Filter searched entries by source provider.

language.description: Filter searched entries by language code (as stored on the entry).

tag.description: Filter to entries that contain this tag.

participant.description: Filter to entries that include this participant.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

offset.description: Number of results to skip before returning search results.

tool_schemas.name: createApiKey
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key for the authenticated API client and returns the key once (along with key metadata). Only active clients may create keys. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is suspended/deleted, RATE_LIMITED if the client exceeds its configured limit, and VALIDATION_ERROR if the request is invalid.

scopes.description: Scopes granted to the new API key.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for the key. If omitted, the key does not expire.

tool_schemas.name: getApiKeys
tool_schemas.description: Lists API keys belonging to the authenticated API client with pagination and optional filtering. Does not return the raw secret key. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not active, RATE_LIMITED if the client exceeds its configured limit, and VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter is invalid.

limit.description: Maximum number of keys to return.

offset.description: Number of keys to skip before returning results.

tool_schemas.name: updateApiKey
tool_schemas.description: Updates an API key owned by the authenticated API client, including lifecycle transitions (active→revoked/expired). Cannot reactivate revoked/expired keys. Does not return the raw secret key. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the key does not exist for this client, FORBIDDEN if the client is not active or the transition is not allowed, RATE_LIMITED if the client exceeds its configured limit, and VALIDATION_ERROR if the request is invalid.

api_key_id.description: The API key ID to update.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the key. Only active→revoked/expired is permitted.

expires_at.description: Set or update the key expiration timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: upsertLifelogEntry
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a lifelog entry for the authenticated API client using (source_provider, provider_entry_id) as the idempotency key. May transition lifecycle status only along allowed transitions. Returns the upserted entry. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not active or the caller lacks write permission, RATE_LIMITED if the client exceeds its configured limit, and VALIDATION_ERROR if the request violates constraints (including invalid status transitions).

source_provider.description: Source provider for the entry (used with provider_entry_id for idempotent upsert).

provider_entry_id.description: Provider-specific entry identifier (unique per client and source_provider).

status.description: Desired lifecycle status. Must follow allowed transitions for existing entries.

summary.description: Optional summary. Required with status=available if content_text is not provided.

content_text.description: Optional full text content. Required with status=available if summary is not provided.

language.description: Language code for the entry content (as stored).

raw_payload.description: Optional raw provider payload for debugging/auditing.

tool_schemas.name: getSearchRequests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded search requests for the authenticated API client for analytics and debugging, with pagination and optional filtering by status and time range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not active or the caller lacks permission, RATE_LIMITED if the client exceeds its configured limit, and VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter is invalid.

created_at_gte.description: Only return requests created at or after this timestamp.

created_at_lte.description: Only return requests created at or before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of search requests to return.

offset.description: Number of search requests to skip before returning results.

sort.description: Sort order for returned search requests.

metadata.name: Limitless AI Lifelog Access
metadata.description: This backend stores users' Limitless AI lifelog entries (recorded moments) and supports listing all entries, retrieving a single entry, and searching across entry content/summaries. It also maintains API clients/keys for authentication and keeps an audit trail of searches for rate limiting, analytic
